source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 12 (PDF 258-282), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Human Skeletal and Muscular Systems) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a skeleton? Write its functions.
(Skeleton (dhancha) kya hai? Is ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bones (haddiyan), cartilage (kurri) aur doosre connective tissues mil kar jism ka andaruni dhancha banate hain jise skeleton kehte hain. Yeh jism ko sahara deta hai, ahem aaza ki hifazat karta hai aur harkat aur chalne phirne (locomotion) mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: make an internal framework called skeleton that provides structural support

blocks.prompt:
2 What is periosteum? How is it held to the bone?
(Periosteum kya hai? Yeh haddi se kaise jura rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Periosteum haddi ki satah ko dhanpne wali sakht membrane (jhilli) hai. Collagen fibres ise neeche wale bone tissue se bandhe rakhte hain, jis se haddi ko mazeed taqat aur mazbooti milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Collagen fibres anchor the periosteum to the underlying bone tissue

blocks.prompt:
3 What is a Haversian system? Name its parts.
(Haversian system kya hai? Is ke hisson ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Haversian system compact bone ki bunyadi structural unit hai. Is ke hisse: lamellae (mineral wale matrix ki gol tehein), lacunae jin mein osteocytes hain, canaliculi (chhoti naliyan) aur darmiyani Haversian canal jis mein blood vessels, nerves aur lymphatic vessels hain.

book_ref.quote: The basic structural units of compact bone are called Haversian systems

blocks.prompt:
4 What are lamellae? What do they contain?
(Lamellae kya hain? In mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lamellae Haversian system mein mineral wale extracellular matrix ki gol (concentric) tehein hain. In mein collagen fibres aur calcium phosphate ke chhote soi jaise crystals hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These are concentric layers of mineralized extracellular matrix

blocks.prompt:
5 Give reason: bone is both strong and flexible.
(Wajah batayein: haddi mazboot bhi hai aur lachakdar bhi.)
blocks.explanation: Lamellae ke calcium phosphate crystals bhurbhure magar sakht hain aur haddi ko bari taqat dete hain, jab ke collagen lachakdar magar kamzor hai. Dono mil kar haddi ko mazboot aur lachakdar banate hain.

book_ref.quote: The crystals are brittle but rigid, giving bone great strength.

blocks.prompt:
6 What are canaliculi? Write their role.
(Canaliculi kya hain? In ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Canaliculi Haversian system ki chhoti naliyan hain. Yeh lacunae mein mojood osteocytes ko aapas mein aur Haversian canal se jorti hain.

book_ref.quote: by small channels called canaliculi

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between red bone marrow and yellow bone marrow.
(Red bone marrow aur yellow bone marrow mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Red marrow khoon ke cells banata hai; yellow marrow lambi haddiyon ke shaft mein charbi ka zakheera hai.

book_ref.quote: Many bones also contain a soft tissue called bone marrow

rows: Spongy bone, lambi haddiyon ke sire, pasliyan, vertebrae, sternum aur pelvis mein
Lambi haddiyon ke shaft mein
Red blood cells, platelets aur white blood cells banata hai
Zyada tar fat cells; energy ka zakheera
Khoon banane wala tissue
Shadeed khoon behne par red marrow ban kar khoon ke cells bana sakta hai

blocks.prompt:
8 Differentiate between epiphysis and diaphysis.
(Epiphysis aur diaphysis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono lambi haddi ke hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: the middle part along the length of bone is called diaphysis or shaft

rows: Haddi ke chaure sire
Haddi ki lambai ka darmiyani hissa
Haddi ke dono siron par
Shaft bhi kehlata hai

blocks.prompt:
9 Give reason: bones are not dry, rigid structures.
(Wajah batayein: haddiyan khushk aur be-jaan sakht cheezein nahi hain.)
blocks.explanation: Haddiyan sirf khushk aur sakht nazar aati hain. Asal mein yeh geeli, zinda tissues hain jin mein zinda bone cells (osteoblasts, osteocytes, osteoclasts), blood vessels aur nerves hain; apni tadaad aur size ke bawajood yeh jism ke wazan ka 20% se kam hain.

book_ref.quote: They are moist, living tissues.

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between osteoblasts and osteoclasts.
(Osteoblasts aur osteoclasts mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik haddi banata hai, doosra haddi torta hai.

book_ref.quote: The work of osteoclasts is important to the growth and repair of bone.

rows: Haddi banane wale cells
Haddi tor kar jazb karne wale cells
Unmineralized ground substance banate aur kharij karte hain
Haddi tor kar khoon mein calcium aur phosphate chhorte hain
Matrix mein ghir kar osteocytes ban jate hain
Macrophages se bante hain

blocks.prompt:
11 What is osteogenesis? Name its two pathways.
(Osteogenesis kya hai? Is ke do raaste (pathways) batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Osteogenesis haddi banne ka amal hai; yeh embryo mein shuru ho kar saari zindagi jari rehta hai. Is ke do raaste: (1) lambi haddiyon (maslan femur, humerus) ka cartilage se banna, aur (2) kuch haddiyon (maslan khopri ki kuch haddiyan) ka cartilage ke baghair seedha sakht haddi banna.

book_ref.quote: There are two primary pathways of osteogenesis.

blocks.prompt:
12 What is the role of blood vessels in the formation of a long bone?
(Lambi haddi banne mein blood vessels ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab cartilage ka darmiyan calcify ho kar chondrocytes mar jate hain to khali jaghein reh jati hain. Blood vessels in mein dakhil ho kar osteoblasts late hain jo haddi banate hain, aur osteoclasts jo calcified cartilage tor kar mazeed haddi ke liye jagah banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Blood vessels penetrate these cavities and introduce osteoblasts and osteoclasts.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is bone remodelling?
(Bone remodelling kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haddiyan poori ban jane ke baad bhi osteogenesis bone remodelling ki shakal mein jari rehta hai: osteoclasts purani haddi torte hain aur osteoblasts nayi haddi banate hain.

book_ref.quote: This ongoing process involves the breakdown of old bone by osteoclasts

blocks.prompt:
14 Where does cartilage remain throughout life? Why?
(Cartilage saari zindagi kahan rehti hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Foetus ki zyada tar cartilage haddi ban jati hai, magar kuch saari zindagi lachak dene ke liye rehti hai: haddiyon ke darmiyan, naak ke sire, bahari kaan aur trachea ke andar ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: some cartilage remains throughout life and provides flexibility

blocks.prompt:
15 What is perichondrium? Write its role.
(Perichondrium kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Perichondrium cartilage ko gherne wali connective tissue ki teh hai. Is mein blood vessels, lymphatic vessels aur nerves hoti hain jo cartilage tissue ko supply deti hain.

book_ref.quote: It contains blood vessels, lymphatic vessels, and nerves that supply the cartilage tissue.

blocks.prompt:
16 Give reason: cartilage heals very slowly.
(Wajah batayein: cartilage bohat aahista theek hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Doosre connective tissues ke baraks cartilage matrix ke andar blood vessels nahi hoti. Is ke cells ko sirf diffusion (phailao) se khurak milti hai, is liye cartilage bohat aahista theek hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Because of this, it heals very slowly.

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between hyaline cartilage and fibrocartilage.
(Hyaline cartilage aur fibrocartilage mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cartilage ki qismein hain jo mukhtalif jaghon par hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Cartilage can be classified into three types.

rows: Cartilage ki sab se aam qisam
Jahan jism par zyada dabao aur khinchao ho wahan hoti hai
Naak, trachea aur joints mein haddiyon ki satahon par
Intervertebral discs aur pubic symphysis mein
Pehli pasli aur sternum ko jorti hai
Pubic symphysis aur intervertebral discs mein haddiyan jorti hai

blocks.prompt:
18 Differentiate between bone and cartilage.
(Bone aur cartilage mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono skeleton ke connective tissues hain.

book_ref.quote: Has limited ability to repair itself, as it has no direct blood supply

rows: Periosteum se dhaki
Perichondrium se dhaki
Cells: osteoblasts, osteocytes aur osteoclasts
Cells: chondrocytes
Matrix mein calcium crystals aur collagen fibres
Matrix mein collagen aur doosre fibres
Blood vessels mojood
Blood vessels nahi
Saari zindagi barh aur marammat kar sakti hai
Marammat ki salahiyat kam, kyun ke seedhi blood supply nahi

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between cranial bones and facial bones.
(Cranial bones aur facial bones mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono 22 haddiyon wali khopri ki haddiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Fourteen facial bones are attached to the cranium.

rows: Aath haddiyan
Chaudah haddiyan
Cranium (dimagh ka dabba) banati hain
Cranium se juri hoti hain
Jora: parietal aur temporal
Jora: lacrimal, zygomatic, nasal, inferior nasal concha, maxilla, palatine
Be-jora: frontal, occipital, ethmoid, sphenoid
Be-jora: mandible (jabre ki haddi) aur vomer

blocks.prompt:
20 What are ear ossicles? How many are there?
(Ear ossicles kya hain? Yeh kitni hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ossicles darmiyani kaan ki chhoti haddiyan hain: malleus, incus aur stapes. Kul 6 ossicles (3 jore) hain, har darmiyani kaan mein teen.

book_ref.quote: There are 6 bones (3 pairs) in middle ears.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is the hyoid bone? Write one special feature of it.
(Hyoid bone kya hai? Is ki aik khaas baat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hyoid gardan ki haddi hai: khopri ki bunyad par zabaan ke neeche chhoti akeli haddi. Is ki khaas baat yeh hai ke yeh sar ki kisi doosri haddi se jor nahi banati.

book_ref.quote: Hyoid bone is a small single bone which lies at the base of skull below the tongue.

blocks.prompt:
22 What is the sacrum? With which bones does it articulate?
(Sacrum kya hai? Yeh kin haddiyon se jurta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sacrum paanch jure hue sacral vertebrae se banta hai. Yeh koolhe ki iliac haddiyon se jur kar pelvis ki pichhli taraf banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The sacrum articulates with the iliac bones of the hip to form the back of the pelvis.

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between clavicle and scapula.
(Clavicle aur scapula mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono pectoral girdle ki haddiyan hain, har aik ka aik jora.

book_ref.quote: One end of each clavicle articulates with the sternum.

rows: Hasli ki haddi (collar bone)
Kandhe ki haddi (shoulder bone)
Aik sira sternum se aur doosra scapula se jurta hai
Clavicle se jurti hai

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between ulna and radius.
(Ulna aur radius mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono forelimb ki lambi haddiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Ulna is slightly bigger than radius.

rows: Bazu ki andar wali taraf
Bahar wali (angoothe ki) taraf
Thori bari
Thori chhoti
Forelimb ki lambi haddi
Lambi haddi; carpals ki upar wali qatar is se jur kar kalai ka jor banati hai

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between carpals and tarsals.
(Carpals aur tarsals mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono chhoti haddiyan hain; carpals forelimb mein aur tarsals hindlimb mein. (Book mein 'carpels' chhapa hai; sahi lafz carpals hai.)

book_ref.quote: These are short bones which are tightly attached to form the ankle.

rows: Aath haddiyan
Saat haddiyan
Do qataron mein, kalai banati hain
Mazbooti se jur kar takhna banati hain
Upar wali qatar radius se jur kar kalai ka jor banati hai
Metatarsals se jurti hain

blocks.prompt:
26 What is the acetabulum? What fits into it?
(Acetabulum kya hai? Is mein kya fit hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acetabulum har hip bone mein haddi ka socket hai jo is ki teen haddiyon (ilium, ischium aur pubis) ke jurne se banta hai. Femur ka sar is mein fit hota hai.

book_ref.quote: that is composed of the fusion of three bones

blocks.prompt:
27 What is the pubic symphysis?
(Pubic symphysis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pubic symphysis aik cartilaginous joint hai jo jism ki darmiyani lakeer par pubic haddiyon ko jor kar dono hip bones ko aage se milata hai. Is ki haddiyan fibrocartilage se jurti hain.

book_ref.quote: a cartilaginous joint that connects the pubic bones at the midline of the body

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between tibia and fibula.
(Tibia aur fibula mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono nichli taang ki haddiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: Fibula or outer bone is a thin bone that joins the tibia

rows: Pindli ki haddi (shin bone)
Bahar wali haddi
Taang ki bari haddi
Patli haddi
Nichli taang ki asal haddi
Ghutne ke zara neeche aur takhne ke zara upar tibia se jurti hai

blocks.prompt:
29 What is the patella? Where is it located?
(Patella kya hai? Yeh kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Patella ya kneecap (ghutne ki chakni) har hindlimb ki 30 haddiyon mein se aik hai. Yeh ghutne ke upar se guzarne wale lambe tendon mein dhansi hoti hai; quadriceps is par insert hote hain.

book_ref.quote: It is embedded in a long tendon which runs over the knee joint.

blocks.prompt:
30 What is a joint? Name its three major kinds with their movement.
(Joint kya hai? Is ki teen bari qismein aur un ki harkat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Joint (jor) woh jagah hai jahan do haddiyan ya haddi aur cartilage milti hain. Qismein: fibrous joints (na hilne wale), cartilaginous joints (thore hilne wale) aur synovial joints (azadi se hilne wale).

book_ref.quote: Three major kinds of joints are found in human body

blocks.prompt:
31 What is articular cartilage? Write its function.
(Articular cartilage kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Articular cartilage chikni, sakht aur lachakdar hyaline cartilage hai jo synovial joint mein haddiyon ke siron ko dhanpti hai. Yeh harkat ke liye chikni aur bina ragar (friction) ki satah deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It provides a smooth and frictionless surface for movement.

blocks.prompt:
32 What is the fibrous capsule of a synovial joint? What is it made of?
(Synovial joint ka fibrous capsule kya hai? Yeh kis se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fibrous capsule synovial joint ko gherta hai aur haddiyon ko jore rakhta hai. Is ki bahari teh ligaments ki aur andaruni teh synovial membrane ki hai jo synovial fluid kharij karti hai; yeh fluid jor ko chikna rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: A fibrous capsule surrounds the synovial joint and helps to hold the bones together.

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between ball-and-socket joint and hinge joint.
(Ball-and-socket joint aur hinge joint mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono synovial joints hain jin ki harkat ki had mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: Ball-and-socket joints allow motion in all directions e.g., shoulder

rows: Har simt mein harkat
Darwaze ke qabze ki tarah sirf aik plane mein harkat
Misalein: kandhe aur koolhe ke jor
Misalein: kohni aur ghutne ke jor

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between pivot joint and gliding joint.
(Pivot joint aur gliding joint mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono synovial joints hain.

book_ref.quote: Gliding joints allow gliding movements between bones

rows: Aik axis ke gird ghumao
Haddiyon ke darmiyan phisalne wali harkat
Misaal: gardan ke pehle aur doosre vertebra ka jor
Misalein: vertebrae ke darmiyan aur kalai aur takhne ki haddiyon ke jor

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between ellipsoidal joint and saddle joint.
(Ellipsoidal joint aur saddle joint mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono do planes mein harkat dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Saddle joints allow movement in two planes because

rows: Do planes mein harkat, ghumao nahi
Do planes mein harkat, kyun ke aik haddi ki satah concave aur doosri ki convex hai
Misaal: kalai aur radius ka jor
Misaal: angoothe ka jor

blocks.prompt:
36 What is joint transplantation?
(Joint transplantation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Joint transplantation aik surgical amal hai jis mein kharab jor ko donor ke sehatmand qudrati jor ya masnooi (artificial) jor se badla jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a surgical procedure in which a damaged joint is replaced

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between total joint replacement and partial joint replacement.
(Total joint replacement aur partial joint replacement mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono joint transplantation ki qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: only the damaged part of the joint is replaced with an artificial component

rows: Poora kharab jor badla jata hai
Jor ka sirf kharab hissa badla jata hai
Metal, plastic ya ceramic ke masnooi jor se
Masnooi hisse (component) se
Poora jor tabdeel
Aksar ghutne ke jor mein

blocks.prompt:
38 What is chondrocyte implantation?
(Chondrocyte implantation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chondrocyte implantation joint transplantation ki aik qisam hai jis mein mareez ke apne jor se chondrocytes (cartilage cells) le kar kharab jor mein lagaye jate hain. Yeh aksar ghutne ke jor mein kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Chondrocyte implantation: In this procedure

blocks.prompt:
39 How do the human pelvis and buttock muscles help in bipedal posture?
(Insani pelvis aur koolhe ke muscles do paon par chalne (bipedal posture) mein kaise madad dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Insani pelvis chhota aur chaura hai jo dhar ko mustahkam rakhta aur jism ka wazan do taangon par sambhalta hai. Koolhe ke muscles insanon mein bohat bare hain; yeh dhar ko mustahkam rakhte aur chalte waqt jism ko aage dhakelte hain.

book_ref.quote: Human pelvis is shorter and broader

blocks.prompt:
40 How do the femur and toes of humans suit walking on two legs?
(Insan ka femur aur paon ki ungliyan do taangon par chalne ke liye kaise mozoon hain?)
blocks.explanation: Insani femur ghutne ki taraf andar ko jhuka hai, jis se jism ka centre of mass paon ke upar rehta hai aur khare hone aur chalne mein tawazun milta hai. Ungliyan chhoti aur kam pakarne wali (less prehensile) hain, is liye paon chalne aur daurne mein behtar lever ka kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The human femur is also angled inward towards the knee joint

blocks.prompt:
41 Name three problems caused by improper posture.
(Ghalat posture se hone wale teen masail ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Vertebral misalignment: kamar aur gardan ka dard aur herniated discs. (2) Joint strain: gardan, kandhon, koolhon aur ghutnon mein dard aur soojan, shayad arthritis. (3) Muscle imbalance: zyada aur kam istemal hone wale muscles haddiyon aur joron ko seedh se hata dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Improper posture can negatively affect bones and joints

blocks.prompt:
42 Which parts of the skeletal system can be affected by its disorders?
(Skeletal system ki bimariyan is ke kin hisson ko mutasir kar sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Skeletal system ki bimariyan is ke kisi bhi hisse ki banawat aur kaam ko mutasir kar sakti hain, jis mein haddiyan, joints aur connective tissues shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Skeletal system is susceptible to a wide range of disorders

blocks.prompt:
43 What is the role of intervertebral discs? What can cause a slipped disc?
(Intervertebral discs ka kya kaam hai? Slipped disc ki kya wajahen ho sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vertebrae ke darmiyan intervertebral discs jhatka jazb karne wale (shock absorbers) hain aur harkat mein madad dete hain. Slipped disc chot, umr ke saath ghisao ya reerh ki haddi par baar baar dabao se ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: act as shock absorbers and help in movement

blocks.prompt:
44 Differentiate between disc slip and spondylosis.
(Disc slip aur spondylosis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono reerh ki haddi ki bimariyan hain jo nerves ya spinal cord par dabao daal sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: It may result in narrowing and fusion of intervertebral disc

rows: Disc ki bahari teh phat kar andar ka gel jaisa maada bahar nikalta hai
Vertebrae, discs, ligaments ya cartilage ka ghisna (degeneration)
Chot, umr ki tabdeeliyon ya baar baar dabao se
Zyada tar umr ke saath discs ka qudrati ghisao; genes, chot, ghalat posture aur motapa bhi
Alamaat: dard, sun hona, jhunjhunahat, kamzori; shadeed surat mein bowel ya bladder ki kharabi
Alamaat: kamar ya gardan dard, akraao aur harkat kam hona

blocks.prompt:
45 Write the causes of spondylosis.
(Spondylosis ki wajahen likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sab se aam wajah intervertebral discs ka qudrati ghisao hai. Yeh umr, genetic factors, chot aur lambe arse tak ghalat posture aur motape se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The most common cause is the natural degeneration of intervertebral discs.

blocks.prompt:
46 What is the sciatic nerve? Why can a slipped disc cause sciatica?
(Sciatic nerve kya hai? Slipped disc se sciatica kyun ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sciatic nerve kamar ke nichle hisse se shuru ho kar koolhon se hoti hui har taang mein jati hai. Herniated ya ubhri disc is nerve par dabao daal sakti hai; sciatic nerve ka yeh dabna ya irritation hi sciatica hai.

book_ref.quote: Sciatica means compression or irritation of the sciatic nerve.

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between rheumatoid arthritis and gouty arthritis.
(Rheumatoid arthritis aur gouty arthritis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono arthritis (joron ki soojan wali halat) ki qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: Gouty arthritis (or gout) occurs when there is a build-up of uric acid

rows: Autoimmune bimari ka nateeja
Khoon mein uric acid jama hone se
Synovial membrane soojh jati hai
Uric acid joron mein crystals bana kar soojan paida karta hai
Zyada tar kalai aur haath
Zyada tar bare angoothe ka jor; ghutne, kalai aur ungliyan bhi

blocks.prompt:
48 What is arthritis? Name its common symptoms.
(Arthritis kya hai? Is ki aam alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Arthritis joron ko mutasir karne wali mukhtalif soojan (inflammation) ki halaton ka naam hai. Har qisam mein jor ka dard aur akraao hota hai; is ke ilawa surkhi, garmi aur soojan bhi ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Symptoms of all types include joint pain and stiffness.

blocks.prompt:
49 What is osteoporosis?
(Osteoporosis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osteoporosis haddiyon ki kamzori ki halat hai jis mein haddiyan asani se toot jati hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab bone density (haddi ki ghanapan) kam ho jaye aur haddiyan nazuk aur masaam daar (porous) ho jayein.

book_ref.quote: It occurs when bone density decreases

blocks.prompt:
50 Why are calcium and vitamin D important for preventing osteoporosis?
(Osteoporosis se bachne ke liye calcium aur vitamin D kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Calcium haddi ki taqat ke liye zaroori hai, aur vitamin D jism ko calcium jazb karne mein madad deta hai. Khurak mein in ki kami haddi ki sehat bigaarti hai aur osteoporosis ki wajah banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Calcium is crucial for bone strength

blocks.prompt:
51 Name two lifestyle factors and one treatment that increase the risk of osteoporosis.
(Osteoporosis ka khatra barhane wale do lifestyle factors aur aik ilaj ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lifestyle factors: wazan uthane wali warzish ki kami; smoking aur sharab noshi. Ilaj: lambe arse tak corticosteroids ka istemal.

book_ref.quote: Smoking and alcohol consumption can also increase the risk of osteoporosis.

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between dislocation and sprain.
(Dislocation aur sprain mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono joron ki aam chotein hain.

book_ref.quote: Joints can be subject to a variety of injuries

rows: Jor ki haddiyan apni asal jagah se bahar nikal jati hain
Jor ki haddiyan jorne wale ligaments ki chot
Achanak chot se; rheumatoid arthritis se bhi
Jab jor ko us ki aam had se zyada mora jaye
Shadeed surat mein muscles, ligaments aur tendons phat jate hain
Ligaments khinch ya phat jate hain; aam tor par takhna, ghutna, kalai
Doctor wapas bithata hai; khinche ligaments ke liye surgery
Aam tor par physical therapy aur patti (dressing)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction yaad rakhein: utra hua jor physiotherapist nahi, doctor wapas bithata hai (aksar X-ray ke baad aur dard ki dawa ya anaesthesia ke saath). Physiotherapy baad mein sehat yabi ke liye hai.

blocks.prompt:
53 Write the symptoms of a dislocation.
(Dislocation ki alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dislocation ki alamaat: soojan, shadeed dard aur mutasira jor ka hil na sakna. Shadeed dislocation muscles, ligaments aur tendons ko bhi phaar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Symptoms include swelling, intense pain, and immobility of the affected joint.

blocks.prompt:
54 How is a sprain treated?
(Sprain ka ilaj kaise kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sprain ka ilaj aam tor par physical therapy se hota hai. Patti (dressing) ki jati hai taa ke moch wala hissa be-harkat rahe aur sahara mile.

book_ref.quote: Dressings is done to immobilize the sprain and provide support.

blocks.prompt:
55 Name the first aid steps for a dislocation or sprain.
(Dislocation ya sprain ki first aid ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Sling ya splint se hissa be-harkat karein; jor khud seedha na karein. (2) Ice pack ya thandi patti lagayein. (3) Mumkin ho to mutasira hissa upar uthayein. (4) Doctor ki madad lein: 1122 par call karein ya hospital le jayein.

book_ref.quote: First aid treatment for dislocation and sprain includes the following steps

blocks.prompt:
56 Why are ice and elevation of the limb used in the first aid of a dislocation?
(Dislocation ki first aid mein barf aur hissa upar uthana kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ice pack ya thandi patti soojan aur dard kam karti hai. Mumkin ho to mutasira hissa upar uthane se bhi soojan kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: elevate the affected limb above to help reduce swelling

blocks.prompt:
57 Define muscle. What are muscle fibres?
(Muscle (pattha) ki definition likhein. Muscle fibres kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Muscle woh tissue hai jo munazzam tareeqe se sukar kar jism ke hisson ya poore jism ki harkat paida karta hai. Muscle ke alag alag cells ko muscle fibres ya myofibres kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Muscle is defined as the tissue that can contract

blocks.prompt:
58 Differentiate between skeletal muscle and smooth muscle.
(Skeletal muscle aur smooth muscle mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono insani jism ke muscle tissues hain.

book_ref.quote: Skeletal muscles are responsible for moving parts of the body

rows: Jism ke hisse hilata hai: bazu taangein, dhar aur chehra
Maida, aantein, blood vessels aur doosre andaruni aaza ki deewaron mein
Lambe fibres, baqaida dhariyon wale
Spindle shakal ke fibres, bina dhariyon ke
Har cell mein kayi nuclei
Har cell mein aik nucleus
Voluntary (aam tor par iraade se)
Involuntary (aam tor par iraade se nahi)

blocks.prompt:
59 Write the function of each of the three types of muscle tissue.
(Teeno qisam ke muscle tissues ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Skeletal muscle: skeleton ko hilana. Smooth muscle: khokhle aaza mein cheezon ko aage barhana. Cardiac muscle: khoon pump karna.

book_ref.quote: Human body has three types of muscle tissues

blocks.prompt:
60 Give two examples to show that animals other than humans also use muscles.
(Do misalein dein ke insanon ke ilawa doosre janwar bhi muscles istemal karte hain.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Machhar urte waqt tezi se sukarne wale flight muscles se apne par tezi se hilata hai. (2) Kenchua (earthworm) mitti mein surang banate waqt mazboot muscles se apna jism aas paas ki mitti se aage dhakelta hai.

book_ref.quote: when a mosquito flies, its wings are moved rapidly

blocks.prompt:
61 What are T-tubules? Where do they reach?
(T-tubules kya hain? Yeh kahan tak pohanchti hain?)
blocks.explanation: T-tubules (transverse tubules) khokhli lambi naliyan hain jo sarcolemma ke muscle fibre mein gehrai tak andar jane se banti hain. Yeh sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) ke siron tak pohanchti hain aur impulse ko andar le jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The T-tubules reach the ends of SR.

blocks.prompt:
62 Give reason: skeletal muscle looks striped (striated).
(Wajah batayein: skeletal muscle dhariyon wala (striated) nazar aata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Myofibrils mein moti myosin filaments gehri A-bands aur patli actin filaments halki I-bands banati hain. Yeh baari baari gehri aur halki bands skeletal muscle ko dhariyon wala banati hain.

book_ref.quote: These alternating dark and light bands give skeletal muscle its striped

blocks.prompt:
63 What are Z-lines? Define sarcomere.
(Z-lines kya hain? Sarcomere ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Z-lines protein ki discs hain jin se patli actin filaments juri hoti hain. Myofibril ka do Z-lines ke darmiyan wala hissa sarcomere hai, jo muscle ke sukarne ki sab se chhoti unit hai.

book_ref.quote: The thin actin filaments are attached to protein discs called Z-lines.

blocks.prompt:
64 Summarize the structural organization of a skeletal muscle.
(Skeletal muscle ki banawat ki tarteeb mukhtasar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Skeletal muscle cells ke guchhon se bana hai jinhein muscle fibres kehte hain. Har muscle fibre ke cytoplasm mein myofibrils ke guchhe hain. Har myofibril do qisam ke myofilaments, myosin aur actin, se bana hai.

book_ref.quote: Each muscle fibre contains bundles of myofibrils in its cytoplasm.

blocks.prompt:
65 Differentiate between thick and thin myofilaments.
(Moti (thick) aur patli (thin) myofilaments mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono myofibril ke myofilaments hain.

book_ref.quote: These myosin heads extend from the thick filaments

rows: Taqreeban 16 nm diameter
7-8 nm diameter
Bohat se myosin proteins se bani
Actin, tropomyosin aur troponin se bani
Is se myosin heads nikal kar actin se jurte hain
Actin par myosin binding sites; Z-lines se juri
Gehri A-band banati hai
Halki I-band banati hai

blocks.prompt:
66 What is the M line?
(M line kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: M line sarcomere ki H-band ke darmiyan mojood ho sakne wali gehri lakeer hai. Yeh moti filaments ko mustahkam rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: The center of the H-band may have a dark line

blocks.prompt:
67 Name the roles of the three polypeptides of troponin.
(Troponin ki teen polypeptides ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Troponin patli filaments par mukarrar faslon par hota hai aur is ki teen polypeptides hain: aik inhibitory hai aur actin se jurti hai; doosri tropomyosin se jur kar use jagah par rakhti hai; teesri calcium ions se jurti hai.

book_ref.quote: One polypeptide is inhibitory and binds to actin

blocks.prompt:
68 State the sliding filament model.
(Sliding filament model bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sliding filament model batata hai ke muscle kaise sukarta hai: muscle tab sukarta hai jab is ki patli myofilaments moti myofilaments ke paas se phisal kar zyada had tak un par chadh (overlap) jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The sliding filament model explains how a muscle contracts.

blocks.prompt:
69 What is the role of acetylcholine in muscle contraction?
(Muscle contraction mein acetylcholine ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab nerve impulse muscle tak pohanchta hai to motor neuron synapse par neurotransmitter acetylcholine chhorta hai. Yeh sarcolemma ko apne electrochemical impulses banane par ubharta hai jo fibre ke andar T-tubules tak jate hain.

book_ref.quote: It stimulates the sarcolemma to produce its own electrochemical impulses

blocks.prompt:
70 What is the role of calcium ions in muscle contraction?
(Muscle contraction mein calcium ions ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Impulse sarcoplasmic reticulum tak pohanch kar use cytosol mein calcium ions chhorne par majboor karta hai. Calcium troponin se jurta hai jo tropomyosin ko actin ki myosin binding sites se hata deta hai, yun myosin heads jur sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: The SR releases calcium ions into the cytosol.

blocks.prompt:
71 What is a cross-bridge?
(Cross-bridge kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab actin par binding sites khul jati hain to myosin heads un se jur jate hain. Myosin head aur actin ka yeh rabta cross-bridge hai; phir heads ke jhukne se actin khinchta hai (power stroke).

book_ref.quote: the myosin heads bind to them and form cross-bridges

blocks.prompt:
72 What changes occur in a sarcomere during the power stroke?
(Power stroke ke dauran sarcomere mein kya tabdeeliyan hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sarcomere chhota hota hai: Z-lines qareeb aati hain aur H-zone ghayab ho jata hai. Saath wali A-bands qareeb aati hain magar chhoti nahi hoti. Yeh tamam sarcomeres mein aik saath hota hai, is liye muscle sukarta hai.

book_ref.quote: bringing Z-lines closer together and H-zone disappears

blocks.prompt:
73 What is the role of ATP in separating myosin heads from actin?
(Myosin heads ko actin se alag karne mein ATP ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khainchne ke baad myosin head ko naya ATP milta hai jis se woh actin se alag hota hai. Is ATP ke ADP aur Pi mein tootne se head wapas apni asal shakal mein aata hai aur cross-bridge cycle dobara shuru ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Splitting of this ATP into ADP and Pi puts the head into its original conformation

blocks.prompt:
74 What is rigor mortis? Why does it occur?
(Rigor mortis kya hai? Yeh kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rigor mortis maut ke baad muscles ka akar jana hai. Maut ke baad cells ATP nahi bana sakte, is liye myosin heads aur actin ke cross-bridges toot nahi sakte. Zinda cell mein hamesha itna ATP hota hai ke heads alag ho saken.

book_ref.quote: After death, the cells can no longer produce ATP

blocks.prompt:
75 Differentiate between origin and insertion of a muscle.
(Muscle ke origin aur insertion mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono muscle ke do mukhtalif haddiyon par jurne ke muqamat hain.

book_ref.quote: while the end attached to the bone that moves is the insertion

rows: Woh sira jo contraction mein na hilne wali haddi se jura ho
Woh sira jo hilne wali haddi se jura ho
Misaal: hamstrings pelvic girdle aur femur ke upar se shuru hote hain
Misaal: hamstrings fibula aur tibia ke upar wale hisson par insert hote hain

blocks.prompt:
76 Differentiate between flexor and extensor muscles.
(Flexor aur extensor muscles mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh jor par antagonistic jora banate hain.

book_ref.quote: When the opposing muscle, called extensor, contracts it straightens the bone

rows: Sukar kar jor par haddi ko morta hai
Sukar kar jor par haddi ko seedha karta hai
Jab extensor sukarta hai to yeh dheela hota hai
Jab flexor sukarta hai to yeh dheela hota hai
Ghutne par: hamstrings
Ghutne par: quadriceps

blocks.prompt:
77 Differentiate between hamstrings and quadriceps.
(Hamstrings aur quadriceps mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono raan ke muscle groups hain jo ghutne ka jor hilate hain.

book_ref.quote: Extension, or straightening, of the lower leg is done by the quadriceps.

rows: Raan ke peeche teen muscles ka group
Raan ke aage chaar muscles ka group
Nichli taang ko morte hain (flexion)
Nichli taang ko seedha karte hain (extension)
Origin: pelvic girdle aur femur ka upar wala hissa
Origin: ilium (pelvic girdle ka hissa) aur femur
Insertion: fibula aur tibia ke upar wale hisse
Insertion: patella (ghutne ki chakni) aur tibia

blocks.prompt:
78 What is muscle fatigue? How is it relieved?
(Muscle fatigue (pathon ki thakan) kya hai? Yeh kaise door hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Muscle fatigue lambi ya sakht jismani mehnat ke baad, ya kisi bimari ki wajah se, muscle ki karkardagi mein kami hai. Yeh aam tor par aaraam se behtar hoti hai; shadeed ho to doctor ki zaroorat hai.

book_ref.quote: Muscle fatigue means a decline in muscle performance

blocks.prompt:
79 Give reason: a muscle stops contracting when its ATP supply is used up.
(Wajah batayein: ATP khatam hone par muscle sukarna band kar deta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Warzish ke dauran muscles sukarne ke liye ATP istemal karte hain. Jab ATP khatam ho jaye to muscle sukar nahi sakta; yeh muscle fatigue ki aik wajah hai.

book_ref.quote: When the supply of ATPs is depleted, the muscle is no longer able to contract.

blocks.prompt:
80 How can muscle cramps be relieved?
(Muscle cramps ko kaise door kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mutasira muscle ko aahista se khainchein (stretch) aur malish karein. Us jagah garmi ya thandak lagana aur dard kam karne wali dawaen bhi madad deti hain.

book_ref.quote: To relieve muscle cramps, gently stretch and massage the affected muscle.

blocks.prompt:
81 What is hypocalcaemia? How is it related to tetany?
(Hypocalcaemia kya hai? Is ka tetany se kya taluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hypocalcaemia khoon mein calcium ki kam miqdaar hai. Yeh tetany ki sab se aam wajah hai aur vitamin D ki kami, gurdon ki nakami (renal failure) ya thyroid ki kharabi se ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: which may be due to vitamin D deficiency, renal failure, or thyroid disorders

blocks.prompt:
82 How is tetany caused by salt imbalance treated?
(Namkiyat ke adam tawazun se hone wali tetany ka ilaj kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tetany ka ilaj us ki asal wajah par munhasir hai. Agar namkiyat ka adam tawazun wajah ho to calcium ya magnesium supplements ya intravenous fluids (rag mein drip) de kar electrolyte balance bahaal kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Treatment for tetany depends on the underlying cause.

blocks.prompt:
83 In the rod-and-lever system of the skeleton, what acts as the rod, fulcrum, effort and load?
(Skeleton ke rod aur lever ke nizam mein rod, fulcrum, effort aur load kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Rods: haddiyan. Fulcrum (dhuri): joints. Effort (quwwat): muscles. Load: hilaya jane wala wazan ya mazahmat. Kohni par wazan uthate waqt bazu ki nichli haddiyan (radius aur ulna) lever, kohni fulcrum aur biceps effort hai.

book_ref.quote: Muscles generate the effort or force, while the weight or resistance being moved is the load.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: book mein likha hai ke biceps lever hai. Sahi yeh hai ke lever radius aur ulna (bazu ki nichli haddiyan) hain; biceps sirf quwwat (effort) deta hai.
